category_edits.rationale: Switch both bidirectional Transformer blocks to post-norm across all four category models, retaining the final LayerNorm. This tests whether normalization after each residual sum improves conditioning. The generated predictor imports BERT4RecModel from train.py, so it automatically reconstructs the same architecture with unchanged checkpoint shapes. Embeddings, features, masked-target training, appended-mask inference, loss, optimizer and routing remain fixed.

response.change_summary: Use post-norm BERT4Rec Transformer blocks for all four datasets, consistently during training and prediction.
